findings.finding: The requirement asks for a migration approach including test migrations, reconciliation and fallback. The answer only says "The migration toolkit supports test migrations, automatic reconciliation and rollback". It describes a tool, not an approach (sequence, phases, responsibilities), so an evaluator may score it low against the delivery criterion.
findings.suggestion: Add a short description of the approach. CAP-90 supports phasing: data platform and read-only APIs first, then real-time account services, then migration of products and history. Link the toolkit steps to that phasing and name "rollback" as the fallback mechanism.

findings.finding: The answer says dashboards measure completeness, accuracy and timeliness "for each data product". CAP-42 does not say the dashboards cover every data product. CAP-41 only says each data product has quality rules. The requirement also asks to report data quality, and the answer does not say how results are reported.
findings.suggestion: Remove "for each data product" unless a specialist confirms it, or tie it to CAP-41 (quality rules per data product). Say briefly how results are reported to the bank.
